description: This file defines a PHP class 'Auth_Container_ADOdb' that implements a storage driver for fetching login data from a database using the ADOdb-PHP library. It includes methods for connecting to the database, fetching user data, listing users, adding and removing users, and handles database connection setup and query execution.

classes.name: Auth_Container_ADOdb
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a database-backed authentication storage driver using ADOdb-PHP, supporting user data retrieval, addition, removal, and database connection management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the class with a DSN or connection parameters, setting default options and parsing provided configuration.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a database connection using the provided DSN string or array.

methods.name: _prepare
methods.description: Prepares the database connection, establishing it if not already connected.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query on the database connection.

methods.name: _setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration options for database connection and table structure.

methods.name: _parseOptions
methods.description: Parses and applies configuration options passed as an array.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Retrieves user login data from the database based on username and password, verifying credentials.

methods.name: listUsers
methods.description: Returns a list of all users stored in the database.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a new user with credentials and optional additional data to the database.

methods.name: removeUser
methods.description: Removes a user from the database based on username.
